_comment: Plan 0027's arms. The agent and its tools are the same in all three: Claude Code headless with the published Parallax MCP 0.1.0-beta.4 (its own setup, into an isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR under ~/ParallaxBench/arms/<config>/claude). W2's config adds the hooks (the session row and the nudge) and strict approvals (the window's card), both through beta.4's own setup with PARALLAX_RUN_DIR set to the window's run directory. W0 and W1 have no hooks: with no window they would wait 1.5 s on every event. The approval policy is the task's human.json: in W1 its denied tools are --disallowedTools, in W2 the scripted approver denies them on the card, W0 has no human and no policy.
